name: terrain-mcp
description: MCP server for infrastructure topology — queries the terrain PostgreSQL schema to report on services, servers, MCP servers, and CLI tools. Provides tools: terrain_list_servers, terrain_list_mcp_servers, terrain_list_runnable_services, terrain_list_cli_tools, terrain_get_service_status, terrain_is_running, terrain_infrastructure_summary, terrain_list_dependencies.
health: direct PG query — no HTTP health endpoint
notes: Infrastructure MCP — answers service status questions without inference overhead
